symptom: The first local TeX draft encoded the exponent as overline{f}^{,k}, inserting a comma into the mathematical superscript.
cause: A TeX thin-space backslash was lost while serializing the patch string; the resulting source bytes did not match the direct authority's overline{f}^k.
detection: The lead reread every newly appended TeX line against the personally inspected 5000-dpi authority bands before compiling, and the literal source-line replay exposed the comma immediately.
repair: Replaced only the malformed exponent with overline{f}^k, exactly matching printed p.75. No erroneous PDF or admitted checkpoint was produced.
